text: Hello, boys and girls.Nice to see you again.Welcome back to my English class.In this period, we will go on learning Unit 1, Relatives in Beijing.You are going to read something interesting about Beijing and learn to make some trip plans.Are you ready for the class?Now, please get your student's book and your worksheet ready.First of all, I'd like you to look at the picture and think about the questions.Who are in the picture?They are Kitty, Ben, and their cousins, Lucy and Simon, right?Where are Kitty and Ben now?Since the Li family are invited to visit Beijing, they are probably in Beijing now.What do Simon and Lucy want to do?Maybe they want to introduce themselves to Kitty and Ben, or they want to show Kitty and Ben around Beijing, or they want to take their cousins to taste some delicious food.We don't know the answer for sure.Now, let's read and find out the truth.Please turn to page 5, read the conversation, and check your prediction.Guys, have you finished?Let's check interest.In Chinese, we say 名胜古迹, please read after me.Places of interest.Now, please look at the title and choose the right answer.Where can we possibly find this article?Guys, what should be the are four paragraphs.I'd like you to read about them and match the four paragraphs with their headings.Now, please take out your worksheet and do the match.Thumb is up!Guys, what should be the heading of the first paragraph?The summer palace.Good, how about the one next to it?The Great Wall.How about this one?Tiananmen Square.And what about the last one?The Palace Museum.Good, you have a good each place?You can put the letters in the right places.Now, please read the text on page 5 and complete the table on your worksheet.Good, you have a good understanding of the text.Time is up.Have you finished?As for the first picture, what is the name of the place?What can tourists see?A long wall with towers on it.Good.How about the second picture?Then what can tourists see?The museums about ancient China.How about the third picture?And what can tourists see?They can see swans swimming on the lake.What else?They can also see a lot of old buildings and temples.How about the last picture?They can see the soldiers raising the national flag.Brilliant.You know the details of the places of interest very well now.There are some new words in the introduction.Can you figure out the meanings of them?Please read the text again and find out the meanings of the new words on your worksheet.How about the fourth picture?How about the fifth picture?How about the sixth picture?How about the seventh picture?How about the eighth picture?What is the meaning of raise here?Raise means you move something to a higher place.How about brick?A brick is used for building walls and houses.How about ancient?If a building is ancient, it is very old.What is a stone?A stone is often found in the ground.How about a mountain?A mountain is a very high hill.Excellent.You know the meanings of the new words very well.You see, the four paragraphs are all about places of interest in Beijing.They all have location, features, and the activities that tourists can do.Can you work out the key words for each part?Write down your general impression of each place.I'd like you to read the text, underline, or write down the key words on your
